title: Professional Seller acquisition — capability and ease, three structures

hierarchy: Advantage.Bid leads; one message; navy band closes
one event or message title of 2–6 words

merchandise.treatment: representative Advantage.Bid-owned items, visibly disclosed as representative — never presented as lots

typography.rule: one element may express contrast or material when truthful; brand faces only

transferable_lessons: CENTERED messaging is a valid professional-seller structure; the reference system must carry a RANGE (centered, asymmetric, environmental, merchandise-led)
Professional-seller messaging: capability and ease ('Sell More', 'Reach More Buyers. Move More Inventory.') without showing complicated software
Audience line 'Professional Sellers' as an eyebrow over the headline
'The Smarter Way to Sell.' sits near the logo as campaign messaging — but it must NOT be baked into the logo asset (README): production places it as a separate text element
One red word in a serif headline is a refined alternative to the uppercase red-line treatment
Professional-seller ease/capability language: list, reach, grow
A representative person may appear in GENERIC acquisition/brand creative when disclosed as representative and never presented as a specific customer or a testimonial
Landscape 6:5 acquisition layout with no band is acceptable when the logo is large and the CTA is unmistakable
Blue panels as a corner device are acceptable in blue-accent treatments
Acquisition creative may be visually rich when ONE headline dominates and every other block is subordinate and organised (benefit rows, step band)
Question headline + answer sub-headline is an approved acquisition structure
Light foundation with a warm interior on one side is within the Owner's 'light' preference
Red for the rule, the CTA and script underlines; navy for the headline and the band
A cardboard box as a 'your items' device is an approved narrative prop (representative, no claim)
Logo lockup at 40–50% of width is inside the Owner's comfort for Advantage.Bid-led creative (3P.1 set 30–40%; widen the ceiling to 50%)
An uppercase display headline is acceptable as a deliberate design choice for a short punchy headline (≤ 4 words per line); title style remains the default
Logo-derived blue is a permitted secondary accent; red remains the attention colour (6 of the 8 new Advantage.Bid-led references use a red CTA)
The same concept may ship in two colour treatments within one campaign

brand_frame.band: navy Advantage.Bid band closes the canvas

principle_profile.structure_rule: name the structure chosen and why; consecutive creatives for the same objective rotate structure; a Gold is evidence, not a template

do_not_copy.ornaments: flourishes, decorative frames, stars, crests, gold borders, icon logistics rows
wording: Luxury finds for the discerning collector

omissions: shop-interior photograph for C4 (no generic shop photograph exists; none generated) — C4 not produced
